detail.command:
printf '%s
' '=== APP META ==='; git -C app rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree; git -C app rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true; find app -maxdepth 3 -type f ! -path '*/node_modules/*' ! -path '*/.git/*' ! -name '.env' ! -name '.env.*' | sort | head -n 320; printf '%s
' '=== SERVER META ==='; git -C server rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree; git -C server rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true; find server -maxdepth 3 -type f ! -path '*/node_modules/*' ! -path '*/.git/*' ! -name '.env' ! -name '.env.*' | sort | head -n 320; printf '%s
' '=== PACKAGE MANIFESTS ==='; for f in app/package.json server/package.json; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then echo "--- $f"; sed -n '1,220p' "$f"; fi; done
